title: Bob Fingerman
description: Three outrageous guests of Jabba the Hutt mug for the "camera." "I'd like to think I captured the souls of these characters," comments Bob Fingerman. At the tender age of thirteen, Fingerman saw STAR WARS on its opening day. Since then, the sci-fi bug has manifested itself in comics he's done for HEAVY METAL, Marvel's 2099 UNLIMITED, Dark Horse's ANDREW VACHSS' UNDERGROUND, and his upcoming solo title WHITE LIKE ME (also Dark Horse). Fingerman persists in ruining his eyes, staying up all night "drawing stuff like this."
